forbid.label: No dynamic code execution (eval)
forbid.advice: eval() on any input that can reach a request is RCE. Parse/validate instead.

forbid.label: No dynamic code execution (new Function)
forbid.advice: Build logic explicitly rather than constructing functions from strings.

forbid.label: Wallet RPC auth must not return the raw configured secret
forbid.advice: generateAccessToken must build a signed JWT (createHmac over body_hash+salt+exp); never return ZANO_WALLET_AUTH verbatim as the header.

forbid.label: Daemon RPC must go through DaemonClient.call, not a bare fetch (SSRF)
forbid.advice: Route daemon RPC through DaemonClient.call so redirect:"error" and the timeout are preserved; a remote http node must not be able to redirect or hang it.

require.label: Wallet RPC access token is HMAC-signed (not the raw secret)
dexAuthenticate alias lookup routes through DaemonClient.call
